selected_evidence.requirement: Three-member Galera cluster formed, all nodes Primary/Synced
selected_evidence.summary: node1 bootstraps as size 1; node2 joins making size 2; node3 joins making size 3, all Primary/Synced

selected_evidence.requirement: Writes through any member available on other members
selected_evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 visible on node2 and node3; row inserted on node2 visible on node3; row inserted on node3 visible back on node1 — full mesh replication confirmed

selected_evidence.requirement: Database stays available when one member is down
selected_evidence.summary: node2 stopped; node1 shows cluster size 2/Primary/Synced and accepts a write; node3 accepts a write and sees node1's write, proving continued availability with quorum of 2

selected_evidence.requirement: Automatic resynchronization of a returning member
selected_evidence.summary: node2 restarted after being down; cluster size returns to 3/Primary/Synced and node2's local table already contains the rows written by node1 and node3 while it was offline (automatic IST)

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a.../cluster healthy; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; new boot_id ef456c56...; post-restart cluster size 3/Primary/Synced with intact data
